evals.prompt: /sharpen Plan how to diagnose why a service is slower after a restart. No code is provided. Do not implement, start processes, change configuration, or expand this into a general observability project.
evals.expected_output: A bounded evidence-driven diagnosis plan rather than a rewritten prompt or implementation.
expectations: Plans a reproducible comparison of the actual slow path before and after restart.
Includes an independent check of the proposed explanation, not source speculation alone.
Preserves planning-only mode and does not start processes, mutate files or configuration, or create a broader project.
